text:
The two fixed blocks are Ben–Cara–Dev in three consecutive slots and Hana–Ivo in two consecutive slots, with Hana–Ivo entirely before Ben. Finn must also sit at least three slots before Hana. The only placement that leaves a legal set of slots for Ann, Elif, and Gus is Finn in 1, Hana–Ivo in 5–6, and Ben–Cara–Dev in 7–8–9.

Slots 2, 3, and 4 then hold Elif, Ann, and Gus: Elif before Ivo, exactly one slot between Elif and Gus, Ann before Gus, and Ann three slots from Ivo.
